test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster and the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

EYBRD ∶ VBYIW ∶∶ DAJKO ∶ WZQPL ∶∶ JEWAD ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The logic here is,

EYBRD ∶ VBYIW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9c64e6a3863780dbc48b418e188bd9d0f2ce10ba331c3f133f2f21010c9316d.png] 

And,

DAJKO ∶ WZQPL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f5c202fc34ea673537d2368c85d267d9552a5124b0a93eae382ac8ee3e4e33.png] 

Similarly,

**JEWAD** : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9e0fcf992b4aae0f1539d1efd18e4e0b5fd18ff4706eb7dd79c0b7c54697e16.png] 

Hence, "**QVDZW**" is the correct answer.

2c
